text: 会议指出，要全面客观认识人口老龄化带来的影响，深入实施积极应对人口老龄化国家战略，推动老龄事业全面发展进步。要着力提升老年人服务保障水平，在养老服务、健康促进、社会保障等方面持续用力，健全多层次多支柱养老保险体系，打通居家、社区、机构养老服务联动渠道，扩大普惠养老服务。要针对老年群体特征，丰富银发产品和服务，培育银发消费新场景，更好满足老年人消费需求，实现民生福祉与内需扩容双向促进。（央视新闻）
text_en: The meeting pointed out that it is necessary to comprehensively and objectively understand the impact of population aging, deeply implement the national strategy of actively responding to population aging, and promote the all-round development and progress of undertakings for the elderly. Efforts should be made to improve the level of services and safeguards for the elderly, continue to make sustained efforts in elderly care services, health promotion, and social security, improve the multi-tiered and multi-pillar old-age insurance system, open up channels for coordinated home, community, and institutional elderly care services, and expand inclusive elderly care services. In response to the characteristics of the elderly group, it is necessary to enrich silver economy products and services, cultivate new silver consumption scenarios, better meet the consumption needs of the elderly, and achieve two-way promotion of people's livelihood and welfare and expansion of domestic demand. (CCTV News)
